mapper.insert: INSERT INTO column_transition (workspace_id, from_column, to_column, rule) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{fromColumn}, #{toColumn}, #{rule}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rule = VALUES(rule), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM column_transition WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (from_column = #{columnId} OR to_column = #{columnId})
